original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an S3 bucket suitable for hosting application user uploads with appropriate access controls.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an S3 bucket suitable for hosting application user uploads with appropriate access controls.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'S3 bucket for application user uploads with secure access controls'

Parameters:
  BucketNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix for the S3 bucket name
    Default: app-uploads
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9\-]*'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens

Resources:
  UserUploadsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${BucketNamePrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: DeleteIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      NotificationConfiguration:
        CloudFunctionConfiguration:
          Event: s3:ObjectCreated:*
          Function: !GetAtt UploadProcessorFunction.Arn
      CorsConfiguration:
        CorsRules:
          - AllowedHeaders:
              - '*'
            AllowedMethods:
              - GET
              - PUT
              - POST
              - DELETE
            AllowedOrigins:
              - '*'
            MaxAge: 3000

  UserUploadsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref UserUploadsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub '${UserUploadsBucket}/*'
              - !Ref UserUploadsBucket
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': false
          - Sid: AllowAppAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt AppRole.Arn
            Action:
              - 's3:GetObject'
              - 's3:PutObject'
              - 's3:DeleteObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${UserUploadsBucket}/*'

  AppRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3UploadAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                Resource: !Sub '${UserUploadsBucket}/*'

  UploadProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-upload-processor'
      Runtime: python3.9
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              print("Processing upload event")
              return {'statusCode': 200}

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Description: Name of the created S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref UserUploadsBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BucketName'
  BucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the created S3 bucket
    Value: !GetAtt UserUploadsBucket.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BucketArn'
  AppRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the application role with S3 access
    Value: !GetAtt AppRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppRoleArn'
